classification.difficultyReason: Construct a first-quadrant value table and use symmetry to complete a sine graph over one revolution.

content.prompt: Draw up a table of values of $y=\sin\theta$ for $0^{\circ}\leq\theta\leq90^{\circ}$, correct to two decimal places, using increments of $10^{\circ}$. Using your table of values, plus symmetry, plot the graph of $y=\sin\theta$ for $0^{\circ}\leq\theta\leq360^{\circ}$.

inlines.text: Use equal positive heights at supplementary angles and equal negative heights in the lower half of the cycle.
In degree mode, evaluate the sine at each angle and round to two decimal places.
Plot the table points in the first quadrant. For each first-quadrant angle, use
to obtain the remaining points. Join them with a smooth curve.

spec.description: Complete sine graph over one revolution, with plotted points at ten-degree increments, cardinal-angle ticks and a smooth equation-driven curve.
spec.mathematics: y=sin(theta), 0 degrees through 360 degrees; maximum (90 degrees,1), minimum (270 degrees,-1), zeros at 0,180,360 degrees.
